syllabus: AI literacy course, 7 tagged blocks (~10 contact hours after deduplication)
primary_gate: Deterministic metrics + rule checker. LLM judge is supplementary.

metrics.name: Title Jaccard (deprecated primary)
metrics.why_not_primary: Gemini paraphrases titles ('Introduction to AI' vs 'Introduction to artificial intelligence') so identical structures look different.
metrics.input: Set of lesson title strings per pathway

metrics.name: Block multiset Jaccard
metrics.formula: For block counts c_A, c_B over syllabusBlockId: J = Σ_k min(c_A(k), c_B(k)) / Σ_k max(c_A(k), c_B(k))
metrics.interpretation: 1.0 = identical block coverage; lower = more structural difference. Gate: mean pairwise J < 0.92.

metrics.name: Block sequence Jaccard
metrics.formula: Treat ordered sequence as set of (position, block_id) pairs; standard Jaccard on those sets.

metrics.name: Cluster similarity analysis
metrics.formula: Same as multiset Jaccard, aggregated within same cluster vs across contrasting cluster pairs.

metrics.name: Learning preference invariance (formerly learning style match)
metrics.definition: For 6 style-control profiles that differ from a paired profile only in learning_1 (survey preference), block sequence Jaccard must be ≥ 0.85.
metrics.note: learning_1 affects tutor wording in node descriptions, not syllabus structure.

metrics.name: Rule-based policy checker
metrics.formula: rule_pass_rate = passed_rule_checks / total_applicable_rule_checks across all profiles

metrics.name: Claude LLM judge (supplementary)
metrics.scale: 1-5 per dimension; mean_score = average across dimensions
